normal.notes: Reconnecting to this Mac from your iPhone is much faster. Coming back after a while used to leave you on a black screen for several seconds — most often because this Mac's display had gone to sleep, leaving Overhand with nothing to capture until something woke it. The screen now wakes the moment you connect and stays awake for the session, the connection handshake no longer loses a second to a race, and the picture starts being prepared while you're still connecting. Please update.

beta.notes: First-frame latency on reconnect: wake the display on auth (an asleep display gives ScreenCaptureKit only .idle frames with nil image buffers), re-send the password challenge when the control channel actually opens (it was being written to a not-yet-open channel and dropped, a flat 1.2s), pre-warm the capture engine during the handshake, and repaint the last captured frame when a keyframe is requested on a static desktop.
